# Time

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A concept element representing a temporal reference point or duration.

## Scope note

Treated as the anchor/parent for the Calendar hierarchy (Life > Decade > Year > Quarter > Month > Week > Day). Worth deciding OWL Time alignment before finalizing.

## Broader

- [Calendar](../Calendar/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
